text:
li: quick heads-up: console shows a bunch of flags as \"Applied\" but runtime kept old value for several tenants
li: repro steps: PATCH /api/configs/flag/{id} -> console shows success, runtime logs show validation reject
dan: can you paste the runtime error or a log link?
li: pasted snippet: ```ERROR config.apply failed tenant=acct-742 reason=quota_exceeded limit=1000 current=1023```
maya: ugh. console treats apply as completed when API returns 200 even if runtime queued and later failed :facepalm:
ashwin: we already emit event `config.apply.failed` to telemetry but UI doesn't subscribe to it, it's only in the ingestion pipeline right now
maya: proposal: add a transient state `pending` until runtime ACKs (or NACKs) or a timeout fires -> UI shows spinner and prevents marking as applied
dan: also need to surface the failure reason inline so devs know if it's quota/schema/auth etc.
ops-bot: alert created: CONFIG_APPLY_FAILURE spikes >5 in 10m for service=runtime-config :rotating_light:
li: also saw mismatch in canary percent: console accepted 100% but runtime limited to 25% because of tenant quota; runtime logged a nack later
ashwin: concrete API suggestion: runtime should call back with `runtime_ack` or `runtime_nack` including a reason_code (quota_exceeded, schema_mismatch, auth_denied, conflict)
maya: @ashwin can you draft the reason_code list and short UX copy for the console tooltip?
ashwin: will do. also suggest adding metric `config.apply.latency_ms` histogram so we can alert on slow ACKs
dan: UI nit: show a small \"last-runtime-status\" pill with color (pending/ok/failed) and a link to the raw error in logs
li: can we also add an opt-in safe-auto-rollback? i.e. if runtime_nack -> auto revert after 30s unless a human overrides
maya: prefer manual opt-in. auto-revert for partial rollouts could flip half of customers unexpectedly. auto-revert OK for full pushes if team opts in
ashwin: agreed. implement flag field `auto_revert_on_nack: boolean` default false; console prompts on apply if enabled
li: i'll open a PR for console UX and add integration tests with a telemetry stub to simulate failed applies
dan: i'll pair to spec the API contract when you're ready
li: thanks, will ping in #devex when PR up :thumbsup:
sre-bot: deploy-notice: config-service v2.14.1 will include runtime_ack endpoints; ETA tomorrow 02:00 UTC
maya: perfect. please also add a small chart in rollout panel for apply-fail rate over last 1h
ashwin: added a card to the ops board and drafted alert thresholds, will share link in PR
li: great, closing loop for now. i'll follow up with sample tenant ids and logs link in the PR for repro
